items.note: All three samples put a full-width teal band with the regular-weight 'Overview' title above a row of four outlined stat cards, then a throughput chart with one pink bar, an activity card, and a bordered projects table with outline status pills. Samples 1 and 2 use an ink Refresh button and sample 3 a ghost one. Each sample has one small sticker (on the chart card, beside the band title, or a coin dot). In sample 2 the projects table sits inside a second outlined card.

At phone width the band collapses to the title, one meta line and Refresh. The stat cards stack two by two, the chart and activity cards follow, and the table reflows into stacked label/value blocks with pill filters above. Sample 3 adds 2px arrow row actions. Nothing is cut off. Sample 2 again wraps the projects block in an extra card.

Dark keeps the teal band with ink text, and the button on it becomes paper-filled in samples 1 and 2 and stays a ghost in sample 3. The cards are raised dark gray on a black ground with light outlines. The chart bars invert to paper (sample 3: outlined dark bars) with one pink bar. The current-page pill turns paper, as the spec maps it.

Same stacked structure as mobile light, on a black ground. The paper current-page pill and the paper Search/Refresh buttons stay readable, the teal band keeps its ink text, and the reflowed table blocks keep their outline status pills, each with an icon and a word.

The Projects section owns a yellow band (periwinkle in sample 3) with an ink rule under it. Below come an 'All projects' heading with its count, the All/Active/Paused/Done pill filters, a filter input, and a dense bordered table with a subtle header row. Samples 1 and 3 put the table straight on the paper ground. Sample 2 wraps it in an outer card, so one bordered box sits inside another.

The collapsed band holds the title and one line. The filter pills and the full-width filter input come next, then the table as stacked blocks with underlined project links and outline status pills (sample 3 adds arrow lift buttons). Sample 2 again nests the table box inside an 'All projects' card.

The yellow or periwinkle band keeps ink text on the black ground, and the table box has light outlines and a dark subtle header. The status pills keep their icons and words. The ink current-page pill turns paper in the side nav.

Mobile dark keeps the band and the paper pills in the top nav. The stacked table blocks sit in one outlined dark box with readable secondary labels, and sample 3's arrow buttons are outlined in light ink. No text sits below contrast on the band.

The detail page shares its parent's band color (yellow, or periwinkle in sample 3). The band holds a breadcrumb, the regular-weight project title, an owner meta line, a status pill and Overview/Tasks/Files pill tabs with a raised selected pill. Below it, one outlined card holds the description and four subtle wells or ruled facts (budget, due date, tasks, files).

The band stacks the breadcrumb, title, meta, status pill and tab pills, all in ink. The facts card follows, as a 2x2 well grid (sample 1), stacked wells (sample 2) or ruled rows (sample 3). Spacing is even, and nothing overflows at 390px.

The band keeps its bright fill with ink text. The selected tab pill and status pill turn dark raised with light text, which reads cleanly on yellow and periwinkle. The facts card is raised dark with darker wells on the black ground.

Mobile dark mirrors mobile light: the band holds a dark selected tab pill and status pill, and the outlined dark card holds the description and fact wells. All labels are readable, and the breadcrumb stays above or inside the band consistently in each sample.

The Team section owns its own band (periwinkle, or yellow in sample 3, distinct from that sample's other sections). Below it, one dense bordered table lists people with initial avatars in outlined circles, underlined email links, role, location and an active-project count, with no sticker, as a data screen should be.

The collapsed band holds the title and a two-line meta. The table reflows into one outlined box of person blocks: avatar, name, underlined email, then label/value rows for role, location and projects, with hairline rules between people. Nothing is cramped or clipped.

Dark keeps the band with ink text over a black ground. The people table is an outlined dark box with light text, light-outlined avatars and readable gray email links, and the side-nav current pill is paper.

The stacked person blocks sit in one outlined dark box under the band. Names, emails and values stay readable against the raised dark fill, and the paper current-page pill marks Team in the top strip.

findings.summary: In one sample, the projects table on both the overview and the projects page is wrapped in an extra outlined card holding its heading and filters, so one bordered box sits inside another bordered box. The spec says surfaces never stack two raised layers, and the other samples set the heading, pills and table straight on the paper ground.
